title: Organization Intelligence
description: Reorient across public repositories, inspect current evidence, and follow the sources that need attention.
authority: These views reflect declared source evidence. Strategy, human decisions and acceptance remain with their canonical owners.

messages.NOT_CONFIGURED: No reviewed public snapshot is connected yet. Repository evidence remains unavailable.
messages.REVIEW_BINDING_REQUIRED: The selected snapshot does not yet have the required review binding. Its contents are withheld.
messages.INPUT_UNAVAILABLE: The public snapshot could not be loaded. No repository inventory is inferred from that failure.
messages.INPUT_INVALID: The selected snapshot could not be admitted. Other website pages remain available.
messages.INPUT_INCOMPATIBLE: The selected snapshot uses an unsupported contract. Its contents are withheld until a compatible source is available.
messages.PUBLIC_REQUIRED: The selected input does not satisfy the public evidence boundary. Its contents are withheld.
messages.READY: The admitted public snapshot is available below. Inspect each domain's coverage and source revision before drawing conclusions.
messages.PARTIAL: Some public repository evidence could not be admitted. Valid repositories remain available below; inspect their source revisions and domain coverage independently.
messages.STALE: This snapshot is older than the declared freshness window. Its source revisions and original observations remain visible; it is not current evidence.

snapshot.heading: Evidence snapshot
snapshot.noCount: An unavailable snapshot does not mean there are no repositories, no findings or no work.

now.heading: Now and next attention
now.description: Owner-projected focus, blockers and ready work are shown in their source order. Activity alone does not establish completion or priority.
now.emptyList: No items are projected in this list. Check domain coverage before interpreting an empty view.
now.unavailable: Current focus, blockers and next-ready evidence are unavailable. No strategic or health state is inferred.
now.bounded: Showing the first {shown} of {total} public items. Open repository evidence for the full projected lists.
now.repositoryUnavailable: This repository's Now module is unavailable. Its independent source and coverage evidence remain below.

directory.heading: Repositories
directory.description: Only repositories represented by the admitted public snapshot are listed. This is not a complete organization inventory or a measure of conformance.
directory.noResults: No represented public repositories match these filters. Clear the filters to return to the admitted directory.
directory.unavailable: The public repository directory will appear when a reviewed compatible snapshot is available.
directory.noScript: The complete admitted directory is shown below. Interactive filters and selected-repository links require JavaScript; native evidence disclosures and source links remain available.

coverage.heading: Collection coverage
coverage.description: Collection scope, freshness and applicability are separate. Uncollected or failed evidence never becomes a successful empty inventory.

modules.heading: Organization modules
modules.description: Each endpoint answers one question and retains its own source boundary. A reachable view may still have unavailable, stale or partial evidence.

provenance.heading: Provenance and limits
provenance.description: The host presents a reviewed public projection. Source collection and normalization retain their existing owners, and this page cannot mutate their evidence or establish release acceptance.
provenance.details: Inspect source versions and integrity bindings
